defaults.notes: cadence_days=0 indicates event-driven. expected_entries_per_year=0 indicates not cadence-based.

rules.notes: Per-access events are recorded continuously; perform a periodic access review at least quarterly (90 days).
Review role-to-privilege mappings at least quarterly or upon significant change.
Review separation-of-duties matrix at least annually and upon major role/process changes.
Review credential hygiene and privileged authenticator posture at least monthly; record resets/revocations per event.
Annual security awareness training completion cycle; new-hire training per onboarding.
Per onboarding or screening event (no fixed cadence).
Per offboarding/termination event; access revocation should be same-day where possible.
Routine audit/SIEM review at least weekly (daily is recommended for higher-risk environments).
Review logging sources, retention, and time-sync at least quarterly; record changes per event.
Periodic operational control checks/attestations at least monthly (or per internal policy).
Per incident and per IR test/tabletop exercise (no fixed cadence).
Per maintenance event (scheduled or emergency).
Review removable media/external connection activity at least monthly; record each use/exception per event.
Per sanitization/destruction/return-to-vendor event.
Per visitor entry/exit event.
Review facility/badge access at least monthly; record physical security issues per event.
Review and refresh baselines at least semiannually or when upstream requirements change (e.g., STIG updates).
Per change request/approval/implementation/rollback event.
Review and update risk register at least quarterly; update after major changes/incidents.
Perform formal security assessments at least semiannually or per risk; record findings/retests as performed.
Update POA&M status at least biweekly until closure (weekly is recommended during active remediation).
Vulnerability triage/remediation cycle at least weekly; critical items may require faster SLAs.
Review policies/procedures at least annually and after significant changes/incidents.
Per collector run (no fixed cadence).
Per-event entries when authorizing/revoking remote access; annual recertification of every active authorization (3.1.12, 3.1.13, 3.1.14, 3.1.15).
Per-event entries on connection authorization/decommission; annual review of every active external connection (3.1.20).
Default architecture prohibits portable storage; this register only sees entries when an exception is granted. Event-driven (3.1.21, 3.8.7, 3.8.8).
